summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises a React confirmation-dialog component but its package.json declares a preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file math_init.js at npm install time. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line heavily-obfuscated bundle with hex-encoded identifiers, a large mixed number/char lookup array, and an array-rotating string decoder (WV8StW) — a shape unrelated to a React UI dialog. Using a second, non-Node language runtime to execute an obfuscated local payload during npm install is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern that also evades Node-based supply-chain scanners, and prevents static determination of the payload's network destinations or behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
